thread:
Maria G: Quick async check — sprint milestone alpha is Wed. We need clarity on owners for the kernel prefetch handshake, KV warmup tests, and the infra toggle for GC. Can owners call out timelines?
Alex P: I can own the handshake implementation on the kernel side. Plan to open the PR by EOD Tue. Will include feature-flag gating.
Priya S: I can do the integration + perf harness for KV warmup. Will add an e2e that mocks cold vs warm KV and a microbatch perf job. ETA Wed morning.
Kevin L: Infra note — the KV GC path needs a configurable toggle in helm (so canary can disable GC during rollout). I'll pick that up. Aim to have a helm patch + docs by Wed morning as well.
deploy-bot: Deployment notice: canary slot available in us-west1 for runtime/v2.2-kv-prefetch (slot: canary-3).
Alex P: Quick config snippet I'll land in the PR:
```
--kv-prefetch-window=16  # default 16 tokens
--kv-prefetch-enabled=true
--prefetch-fallback-threshold-ms=150
```
Priya S: Perfect. I'll make the e2e reference that flag and add a perf assertion. Also saw a small regression in microbatch concurrency in the last kernel preview — I'll add a perf test to isolate.
Maria G: Owners summary so far: Alex = kernel handshake (PR Tue EOD), Priya = e2e + perf harness (Wed AM), Kevin = infra helm toggle (Wed AM). Dependencies: Kevin's helm toggle -> staging canary -> Priya's perf runs -> canary rollout.
Priya S: Quick question: what metric should gate the canary? p95-token-latency or tokens/sec? My vote: p95 <= 120ms AND error rate < 0.1% vs baseline.
Alex P: +1 for p95 + error. I'll wire the handshake feature-flag to auto-fallback if p95 > 150ms for safety.
Kevin L: I'll expose the helm toggle as `kv.gc.enabled` and add an annotation for ops to flip during rollout. Will link PR here when ready.
Maria G: I'll update the milestone doc and add the dependency graph. If anyone wants a quick pairing window, propose Alex + Kevin + Priya 11:00am PT tomorrow for 20m.
Alex P: 11:00 works for me. I'll bring a short demo of handshake telemetry.
Priya S: Works. I'll bring failing perf traces.
Kevin L: Works for me.
Maria G: Awesome — leaving this thread open for small async pings. Ping here if you need help or want me to unblock approvals. :thumbsup:
Alex P: FYI putting a short checklist on the PR: unit tests, integration toggle, fallback test, perf baseline.
Priya S: Noted. I'll add the perf job name and threshold to the checklist.
deploy-bot: Canary started: runtime/v2.2-kv-prefetch -> canary-3 (us-west1)
Kevin L: Saw canary start, I'll watch helm logs and flip GC if anything spikes.
Maria G: Thanks team — will close out in milestone doc after the 11am sync.
Alex P: Thanks — will ping when PR is ready for review.
Priya S: Ping me for early review on the e2e.
Maria G: End.
